sentences.text: Appearance:
Shri Hariom Choudhary, learned counsel for the appli  Shri Rahul Solanki, learned Govt.Advocate for the re  ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused,
relating to FIR/Crime No.155/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - Maheshwar, District Khargone (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable u/S 363, 366(A),
376(2)(n), 368 of IPC alongwith Sections 5L/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Prosecution story, in brief, is that at the time of incident, prosecutrix was minor around 17 years of age.
On 25.3.2024 co-accused Vishal took the prosecutrix to village Dhamnod from her house and kept her at applicant's house, who is father of co-accused Vishal.

Thereafter, co-accused Kalu, who is uncle of co-accused Vishal took Vishal and the prosecutrix to Pithampur 2 MCRC-34258-2024 by motorcycle and co-accused Kalu arranged a rented room, where the prosecutrix and co-accused Vishal lived together for around one month.
Meanwhile, co-accused Vishal committed rape upon her repeatedly.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that co-accused Kalu is granted bail by this Court vide order dated 8.7.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.24390/2024.
It is submitted that case of the present applicant is identical with co-accused Kalu.
The applicant has not provided any type of shelter to co-accused Vishal and the prosecutrix.
It is submitted that the applicant is in custody since19.5.2024.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.

5. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant - Gabu shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such 3 MCRC-34258-2024 dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
8. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
